contributionMap.claim: Fair coins: for all n >= n0 (absolute, ineffective; n0 >= 10) and m >= n the unique entropy maximiser is the star with one common colour; up to three extra coins on distinct pairs, four or more on one pair; three colours solved for every m

contributionMap.paperLocation: Theorem B; Section 7 (Proposition 7.1, Lemma 7.2, Theorem 7.3, Corollary 7.4)
